Item_9_Comment:
. Section 2.6: We used the Q test and I
2 test to assess
heterogeneity across studies. When the P value was less than 0.10 in the
Q test or the I
2 statistic was greater than 50% in the I
2 test, significant
heterogeneity was deemed to exist between studies (Higgins et al., 2002;
Kim et al., 2018).
Item_10_Comment:
section 2.6: We assessed publication bias using
Begg’s funnel plot and Egger’s test, and the presence of asymmetry in the
funnel plot or a P value less than 0.05 in Egger’s test indicated the
presence of bias (Egger et al., 1997)
